description:
Welcome to Piku Rhymes! 🌈🎵

A colourful little world of nursery rhymes, cheerful music, playful poems and adorable baby dance adventures!

Join our cute characters as they sing, clap, wiggle and dance through magical gardens, rainbow worlds and joyful everyday moments. From catchy sing-along songs to gentle melodies, Piku Rhymes brings music and imagination together for little listeners and their families.

🎶 Nursery Rhymes & Kids’ Songs
👶 Cute Baby Dance Videos
📖 Playful Poems & Sing-Alongs
🌈 Colourful Animated Adventures
👏 Clap-Along & Movement Songs
🌙 Gentle Songs for Quiet Moments

Our videos are created for toddlers, preschoolers and young children to enjoy alongside their parents and caregivers.

Parents and caregivers, subscribe to Piku Rhymes and join us for more musical adventures!

Piku Rhymes — Sing • Dance • Smile! 💛
